# Caching Errors and Warnings

Messages reported by PostSharp.Patterns.Caching.

| Message | Severity | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <xref:cac001?text=CAC001> | Error | The [Cache] aspect is applied to a method that returns void or Task. |
| <xref:cac002?text=CAC002> | Error | The [InvalidateCache] aspect names a method that does not have the [Cache] aspect. |
| <xref:cac003?text=CAC003> | Error | The invalidating method cannot supply the this instance that is part of the cache key of the cached method. |
| <xref:cac004?text=CAC004> | Error | A parameter of the cached method has no parameter of the same name in the invalidating method. |
| <xref:cac005?text=CAC005> | Error | A parameter of the invalidating method has a type that cannot be assigned to the parameter of the same name of the cached method. |
| <xref:cac006?text=CAC006> | Error | The list of methods that an [InvalidateCache] aspect invalidates contains a null or empty name. |
| <xref:cac007?text=CAC007> | Error | An [InvalidateCache] aspect does not name any method to invalidate. |
| <xref:cac008?text=CAC008> | Error | An [InvalidateCache] aspect names a method that does not exist in the type where the aspect looks for it. |
| <xref:cac009?text=CAC009> | Error | An [InvalidateCache] aspect matches several overloads of the method to invalidate. |
| <xref:cac010?text=CAC010> | Error | The [Cache] aspect is applied to a method with a ref or out parameter. |
| <xref:cac011?text=CAC011> | Warning | A static method, or a method of a struct, uses the default caching service although dependency injection is enabled. |
| <xref:cac012?text=CAC012> | Error | An invalidating method and the method it invalidates use different caching services. |
| <xref:cac013?text=CAC013> | Error | The [Cache] aspect is applied to an async iterator or to an async method that does not return Task<T>. |
